descriptions.notStarted: Manji, a solitary warrior in Perion, has asked to see you. He's never been the type to initiate a conversation, let alone a meeting! It must be something important. Let's go see Manji in Perion.
descriptions.inProgress: Manji says he felt a threatening energy coming from the deep end of the dungeon, so he asked his young apprentice, #bMu Young#k, to investigate. Unfortunately, he hasn't heard from Mu Young since! He'd like you to find the young man. If the last time Manji heard anything from Mu Young was when he was investigating the central dungeon of Victoria, couldn't he still be inside?
descriptions.completed: Manji says he felt a threatening energy coming from the deep end of the dungeon, so he asked his young apprentice, #bMu Young#k, to investigate. Unfortunately, he hasn't heard from Mu Young since! He'd like you to find the young man. If the last time Manji heard anything from Mu Young was when he was investigating the central dungeon of Victoria, couldn't he still be inside? \r\nYou were able to find Manji's apprentice, Mu Young, in the Underground Temple of the central dungeon.
